readers: plugins/source-control/skills/babysit-prs/scripts/babysit_verify_evidence.py reads FAIL verdicts back to the pull request's creation, capped at TOO_OLD_DAYS (80), and PASS verdicts at the current head
.github/scripts/pr-merge/carry-run-cache.mjs RETENTION_DAYS (90) bounds the verdict runs it carries
.github/workflows/pr-require-checks.yml ci-status reads the PASS verdict at the head
scripts/credential-sweep.sh --since defaults to 90 days ago, GitHub's default artifact retention
pr-verify-*.reason: A FAIL verdict must outlive the 80-day FAIL look-back (babysit_verify_evidence.py TOO_OLD_DAYS = 80, ten days under 90): a shorter retention drops earlier FAILs, and the gate then stops refusing verify:earlier-fail and the FAIL cap. scripts/credential-sweep.sh also assumes 90-day artifacts. write-verdict.mjs retentionDays keeps FAIL at max and PASS or PASS-NOTES 30 days (an expired PASS fails closed as verify:missing); the row records the longest.

readers: plugins/source-control/skills/babysit-prs/scripts/babysit_postmerge.py LANE_DISPATCH_ARTIFACT proves a lane dispatch covered a merge
.github/scripts/pr-merge/lane-records.mjs keeps the records the post-merge check proved
pr-merge-dispatched-*.reason: The post-merge check reads the dispatch record of every merge it judges, back to the merges it has not yet judged.
pr-merge-dispatched-*.pending-cut: Under owner review (poteto): about 5,660 artifacts at 90 days.

readers: plugins/source-control/skills/babysit-prs/scripts/babysit_postmerge.py LANE_RERUN_ARTIFACT, read back to merged_since with no age cap
.github/scripts/pr-merge/lane-records.mjs keeps the records the post-merge check proved
pr-merge-rerun-*.reason: The post-merge check reads the lane's re-run record back to merged_since, with no age cap.

readers: plugins/source-control/skills/babysit-prs/scripts/babysit_postmerge.py LANE_ALERT_ARTIFACT (`--lane-alerted`), asked by .github/workflows/pr-merge.yml post-merge-dispatch only for full runs created within LOOKBACK_HOURS (6)
pr-merge-alerted-*.reason: Read back only for full runs created in the last 6 hours (pr-merge.yml LOOKBACK_HOURS), and each record is uploaded after its run was created; 1 day, the minimum, outlasts that window.

readers: .github/actions/upload-lane-transcript/README.md the transcript puller, a daily task outside CI that copies each sealed transcript to its sink
lane-transcript-*.reason: A recorded owner decision on the lane transcript store: CI keeps each encrypted transcript 7 days and a daily puller copies it to the sink, so a week of missed pulls loses nothing.

readers: .github/workflows/pr-run-activity-read.yml a person reading act-turns.json denials by hand

skill-reply-*.pending-cut: 3 days would still cover a weekend; changing the recorded owner decision needs the owner.
